CONTRADICTION on the unconvergeable-journal recovery boundary. requirements.md:1181-1186 (Edge Cases, crash-between-renames bullet) states that when the journal is unconvergeable the Resolver 'attempts no repair at all and Blocks `publication-journal-recovery`, leaving the interrupted targets exactly as found for manual operator intervention (REQ-002 above; AC-047)'. That object is unscoped, and by REQ-001 step (m)'s own write-set definition (requirements.md:317-321) every publication transaction's target set is {facet-manifest.yaml, generated/project-context.resolved.json, resolver-evidence.yaml} or {capability-summary.yaml, resolver-evidence.yaml} - so resolver-evidence.yaml is by construction one of the interrupted targets of any journal this scan can find. Four other normative sites require that same Block to write resolver-evidence.yaml: REQ-001 step (m)'s Block branch ('On the (0) Block this is not merely sufficient but required', requirements.md:333-347), REQ-004's write-mechanism paragraph (:594-599), AC-012 (:858, whose only two exceptions are disabled-legacy-invocation and the self-referential output-schema-validation-failed), and acceptance-tests.md TEST-047 (:93), which states the obligation PER TARGET - 'every interrupted target other than `resolver-evidence.yaml`' byte-identical to its pre-invocation state 'and ... that `resolver-evidence.yaml` itself carries this invocation's own schema-valid Block record' - and records in the same row that asserting only the first half 'would contradict AC-012'. requirements.md's Edge Cases sentence is exactly that first half alone. Downstream failure mode: the Phase-2 implementer of the (0) Block, and the author of the TEST-047 fixture, cannot decide from requirements.md whether the Block must overwrite the interrupted transaction's resolver-evidence.yaml (satisfying AC-012/REQ-001/REQ-004, violating the Edge Case's state claim, and destroying a target of a state the spec elsewhere calls 'the one state no automatic repair may touch') or leave it untouched (satisfying the Edge Case, violating AC-012 and TEST-047). This is a specification-review issue, not an implementation or quality-gate one: both statements are normative Phase-1 text about the same Block, and only an amendment to requirements.md can reconcile them - no implementation choice can satisfy both. Severity Critical: it is a direct contradiction on a fail-closed, no-automatic-repair boundary that hands control to a human operator, and it is the same clause class the package's own record (investigation.md:1486-1500) documents as having split two independent reviewers and forced ruling D(2). Secondary site with the same unscoped object: Security Boundaries requirements.md:1246-1252 ('A mixed generation across a multi-target batch ... leaves it exactly as found'), which reads coherently only because the Evidence carve-out at :1239-1245 precedes it; the Edge Cases bullet has no such carve-out anywhere in it. Remedy shape (no new decision needed - ruling D(2) already decides it): state the live-state obligation per target in requirements.md Edge Cases in TEST-047's own words.
